observation: Architecture critique caught factual inventory drift: plan claimed scope-picker = 2 pill rows + 2 Selects; tree had 3 pill radiogroups + 1 Select (KnowledgeCreateDialog:192 was already a hand-rolled pill, not a Select). Inventory was inherited from the upstream spec's loose count, not re-grepped at plan time. Drove arch score 6/10; corrected to 3+1 in revision (architecture.md:31). Recurring class: adoption-sweep inventories must be tree-verified at plan time, never trusted from an upstream review doc.

Review caught AC2 gap: builder left standalone DaisyUI btn action sites (WorkRoutine/WorkPortfolio/WorkTeam/WorkBet) unmigrated, justifying only the KEEP class (footers + AG5 triggers) under 'builder judgment', but the spec named btn sites as in-scope bypasses. Flagged NOT MET, fixed in 1 round (commit 8c8e0a26). Pattern: plan 'candidate-migrate' items get silently dropped under budget pressure unless the AC gate is explicit and binary.

Both correction loops converged in exactly 1 round: arch critique->revise (6->9, every prior CRITICAL/WARNING tree-verified fixed) and code review->fix (AC2 NOT DONE->DONE, no protected test weakened, no regression). Upfront doc investment preceded all code; TDD red phase (627 lines, commit 195c8ace) froze contracts before impl. Critique/review machinery paid off without thrash.

Both AI5 gaps (AC4 rgba tint sweep, AC2 hand-rolled button) are exactly what an enforced static gate should catch, but neither was gated: eslint-plugin-design has no hand-rolled-button rule (no-handrolled-select covers AG5/ScopePicker only), and no-hardcoded-color matches rgba() literals but is registered at 'warn' not 'error' so the tint bypass would not fail CI. Precedent: AI2/AI4 promoted no-raw-overlay-z / no-dialog-boilerplate / no-local-status-builder warn->error post-migration. Recommend /compound: promote no-hardcoded-color to error + add no-handrolled-button rule so both gaps become CI-fatal.
